name: AS3109
description: High performance voltage controlled four-pole filter with four independent transconductance-amplifier sections that can be interconnected for low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, or all-pass responses. A single control voltage pin exponentially sets the frequency of all four sections together over greater than a 15 octave range with low control-voltage feedthrough. Functionally and pinwise matches the classic SSM2044 (16-pin, four cascaded VCA-buffered gm stages, single shared exp control), the filter chip used in the Roland Juno-106 and widely cloned/reissued since the original went out of production.

pins.name: In1
pins.description: signal input to transconductance amplifier stage 1; Rin internal to the amp is approx. 560ohm, datasheet recommends a trimmed external resistor to this pin (68k to signal, 560ohm to ground in the reference low-pass application)

pins.name: C1
pins.description: integrating capacitor pin for stage 1, to ground; 240pF used in the datasheet's reference low-pass wiring and in the -3dB=250Hz test condition (with 68k input R)

pins.name: Out1
pins.description: buffered output of stage 1; this stage's output buffer has a passive resistor-type load (see gotchas) and a lower max positive drive current (0.6mA min) than stages 2/4

pins.name: In2
pins.description: signal input to transconductance amplifier stage 2; same Rin/external network guidance as In1

pins.name: C2
pins.description: integrating capacitor pin for stage 2, to ground; same sizing guidance as C1

pins.name: Out2
pins.description: buffered output of stage 2; this stage's output buffer has an active current-source load (see gotchas), max positive drive current 1mA min

pins.name: VC
pins.description: control voltage input; exponential U/I converter input that sets the transconductance (and hence cutoff frequency) of all four stages together, -17.5 to -20.5 mV/octave (typ -19)

pins.name: In3
pins.description: signal input to transconductance amplifier stage 3; same Rin/external network guidance as In1

pins.name: C3
pins.description: integrating capacitor pin for stage 3, to ground; same sizing guidance as C1

pins.name: Out3
pins.description: buffered output of stage 3; passive resistor-type load like stage 1, max positive drive current 0.6mA min

pins.name: In4
pins.description: signal input to transconductance amplifier stage 4; same Rin/external network guidance as In1

pins.name: C4
pins.description: integrating capacitor pin for stage 4, to ground; same sizing guidance as C1

pins.name: Out4
pins.description: buffered output of stage 4; active current-source load like stage 2, highest max positive drive current of the four (1.3mA min)

SOIC-16.notes: Pin table and Fig.1 (Circuit Block and Connection Diagram) of the Alfa AS3109 datasheet, 2021 v.1 (rev history: 10-May-2021 preliminary v1, 20-Dec-2021 version 1), page 1/4. AS3109D is the SOIC-16 (150 mil) device type; a DIP-16 pin numbering is stated as identical in the same table. Position confirmed against Fig.1's top-view connection diagram, which lists pins in the same GND/In1/C1/Out1.../VCC order around the package as the pin-info table.

extra.cutoff freq test condition: 250Hz typ per stage, VC=0, C=240pF, R=68k ohm, f-3dB
extra.Rin (internal, per amplifier): ~560 ohm; datasheet recommends trimming the external input network to each IN pin for best performance

typical_application: Classic 4-pole voltage-controlled low-pass filter core (Fig.3 of the datasheet): an exponential converter feeds VC (pin 9) with 1V/octave scaling through a 54k/1k divider; each of the four IN pins gets the signal through a 68k input resistor with a 560ohm pulldown to ground, and each stage's integrating cap (C1-C4) is 240pF; the four stages are cascaded output-to-input to build a steep low-pass response, though the independent sections can equally be wired for high-pass, band-pass, or all-pass. Used in electronic music / synthesizer VCF circuits as a direct successor part for the SSM2044.
gotchas: single VC pin (9) sets the exponential frequency control for all four stages together; there is no per-stage independent cutoff control other than external mixing/scaling circuitry

stages 1 and 3 use a passive resistor-type output buffer load while stages 2 and 4 use an active current-source load; the datasheet explicitly notes their drive behavior differs (asymmetric max output current: 0.6mA for stages 1/3 vs 1-1.3mA for stages 2/4)

internal Rin per amplifier is only ~560 ohm; the datasheet calls out that the external circuit connected to each IN pin must be trimmed for accurate performance, this is not a high-impedance signal input on its own
split supply only, +10V/-10V minimum up to +18V/-18V maximum; no single-rail operation is documented

pin-compatible functional match to the vintage SSM2044 (same 16-pin layout and single shared VC pin), the chip behind the Roland Juno-106's VCF; treat as a modern reissue/clone rather than an SSM part number
datasheet is marked preliminary as of 2021 v.1 (10-May-2021 prelim, 20-Dec-2021 version 1); double-check against a newer revision if one becomes available
